description: Fixed Gemini 2.5 Flash hidden thinking-token truncation and thought-part extraction (set thinkingBudget=0 on 2.5 models, filter out thought parts, raise maxOutputTokens to 2048, add fallback model & warning logs). Zero changes to trading personas, rules, or risk limits.

Batched Alpaca news across all 71 tickers (previously truncated to first 35), re-anchored skewed/wide IEX quotes against fresh bar closes, added 429/5xx HTTP retries, excluded pre-entry wicks from 5-min/30-min SL/TP checks, added EOD_FLAT_CATCHUP for intraday-only agents after missed closes, prevented duplicate near-close cycles, fixed daily report cycles_run_today & post-close finalization, and hardened git pull --rebase in Actions loop.
